added: Scan any NFC tag, sticker, card or fob in Settings, NFC tags and save it with a name, then attach it to a chore now or later.
A chore can have several NFC tags. Add them from the chore's edit sheet by scanning, picking a saved tag, typing an id or writing a new one.
Settings, NFC tags lists every saved tag with the chore it logs, and can attach, detach, rename or forget each one.
changed: Removing a tag from a chore keeps it saved, so it can be attached to another chore without scanning it again.
Writing a tag for a chore that already has one now writes an extra tag instead of a copy of the first.
